tasks.label: Docker: Start PostgreSQL PGVector
tasks.detail: Starts the PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector container on port 5432

tasks.label: Run: SRE Agent App (PGVector - Port 8080)
tasks.detail: Runs sre-agent-app on http://localhost:8080 connected to PostgreSQL PGVector

tasks.label: Run: SRE Agent App (Local Mode / No Docker - Port 8080)
tasks.detail: Runs sre-agent-app on http://localhost:8080 using in-memory SimpleVectorStore (no Docker required)

tasks.label: Run: Playbook RAG Service (PGVector - Port 8081)
tasks.detail: Runs standalone Playbook RAG service on http://localhost:8081

tasks.label: Run: Playbook RAG Service (Local Mode / No Docker - Port 8081)
tasks.detail: Runs standalone Playbook RAG service on http://localhost:8081 using in-memory SimpleVectorStore

tasks.label: Maven: Clean Install & Run Unit Tests
tasks.detail: Builds and installs all modules into local Maven repository so sub-modules can be run independently
